e.title: PDtoolkit (R)
e.summary: PD 评分模型开发与验证 R 工具集：单/双/多元分析、单调分箱、WoE/IV、校准验证
e.body: PDtoolkit（v1.2.0，Djurovic）覆盖违约概率（PD）评级模型开发与验证的最常见步骤：单变量/双变量/多元分析、校准与验证，配套 monobin/monobinShiny 包提供数据变换与建模函数——缺失值插补、数值风险因子单调分箱、类别风险因子分箱、证据权重（WoE）与信息量（IV）计算、WoE 编码、风险因子聚类等。对 RIAA：评分卡/评级模型的 R 侧完整工具集（信用风险、保险核保评分通用方法论）。与 [[scorecardpy]]（Python 评分卡流水线）、[[riskscores]]（整数风险评分优化）形成三语/三法互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]。。
e.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v1.2.0，PD 评级模型开发验证（单/双/多元分析+校准+验证），monobin/monobinShiny 配套
e.summary_en: R toolkit for PD rating-model development and validation: univariate/bivariate/multivariate analysis, monotonic binning, WoE/IV, calibration and validation
e.summary_hk: PD 評分模型開發與驗證 R 工具集：單/雙/多元分析、單調分箱、WoE/IV、校準驗證
e.body_en: PDtoolkit (v1.2.0, Djurovic) covers the most common steps in probability-of-default (PD) rating-model development and validation: univariate, bivariate and multivariate analysis, calibration and validation; together with the companion monobin/monobinShiny packages it provides data-transformation and modelling functions — imputation, monotonic binning of numeric risk factors, binning of categorical risk factors, weights-of-evidence (WoE) and information-value (IV) calculation, WoE coding, risk-factor clustering and more. For RIAA: the R-side complete toolkit for scorecard/rating models (credit risk; the same methodology applies to insurance underwriting scores). Complements [[scorecardpy]] (Python scorecard pipeline) and [[riskscores]] (integer risk-score optimisation) across languages/methods. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: PDtoolkit（v1.2.0，Djurovic）覆蓋違約概率（PD）評級模型開發與驗證的最常見步驟：單變量/雙變量/多元分析、校準與驗證，配套 monobin/monobinShiny 包提供數據變換與建模函數——缺失值插補、數值風險因子單調分箱、類別風險因子分箱、證據權重（WoE）與信息量（IV）計算、WoE 編碼、風險因子聚類等。對 RIAA：評分卡/評級模型的 R 側完整工具集（信用風險、保險核保評分通用方法論）。與 [[scorecardpy]]（Python 評分卡流水線）、[[riskscores]]（整數風險評分優化）形成三語/三法互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]。
